storyline: Theseus, by right of his birth, claimed the precedence, and proffered a request to be the first victim,--a request which the king granted with a sardonic smile, ere he returned.
Unnoticed by all, Ariadne slipped out of the palace, and, under cover of the darkness, entered the prison where Theseus was confined.
There she tremblingly offered him a ball of twine and a sharp sword, bidding him tie one end of the twine to the entrance of the labyrinth, and keep the other in his hand as a.
Like all heroes, he preferred to meet any danger rather than remain inactive: so, mindful of Ariadne's instructions, he fastened his twine to the entrance, and then boldly.
The Minotaur slain, Theseus hastily retraced his footsteps.
